title: Family shell
question: Give the IFTA family its own slim shell (road-office bar for clients, operations bar for staff) on the existing routes, instead of the legacy portal sidebar and office layout. Legacy pages for other families stay as they are.

title: Public chrome
question: On /services/ifta-filing, use a family-scoped bar (wordmark · Services · Log in · Request filing) and a one-line footer instead of the legacy nav, plan bar and footer.

title: Palette hex values
question: The names are locked; the values are not. Proposed: obsidian #121417 · charcoal #1D2024 · stone white #EDE9E1 · platinum / silver #C3C8CD · warm champagne #E2CFA0 · signature gold #C9A227 (SITE00 brand-family registry; the legacy app used #D4A017), plus black #0B0B0C and a muted stone #A39D93 from the Brain.

title: IFTA availability on the public page
question: The public page says GO / Get Started; the catalog says PREPARING and fuel tax is INTERNAL_ONLY. Recommendation: REQUEST FILING opens a quote request, with the honest line "AIO staff file with your base jurisdiction".
recommendation: Request filing as a quote request

title: Sentence case inside records
question: Uppercase primary is locked and stays on every UI element. Approve one exception: sentence case inside paper records and message threads (receipt lines, return-summary lines, AIO and client messages), for document legibility. Typefaces stay as they are until the IDNTY type work.

title: Monogram source
question: The lock says nav uses the simple monogram only, but no standalone monogram file exists. Crop the existing mark from the current lockup (no generation) until the IDNTY mark work delivers one.
recommendation: Crop the mark from the lockup

title: Imagery
question: No photography in this family. Retire the hero truck photo (IDNTY prohibits generic semi hero shots). Keep one optional fuel-island-at-night slot marked GENERATION_REQUIRED; nothing generated.

title: Objects inside legacy hosts
question: The quarter card (My Office) and the correction slip (Inbox) are family-designed objects mounted in the legacy hosts. The Vault handoff gets a family route: /portal/vault/tax-fuel/ifta.
alternative: Wait until those families are rebuilt

title: Brain update: Under AIO review
question: Add UNDER_AIO_REVIEW (sprint §6) to the IFTA receipt classes in the Experience Brain.

title: Brain update: activity events
question: Add mileage imported, review started, correction requested, payment recorded and vault package created (sprint §19) to the contract activity events.

title: Brain update: staff buckets
question: Split the contract COMPLETE bucket into FILED and PAYMENT PENDING (sprint §13).

title: Demo anchoring
question: Pioneer Fleet is the primary enrolled quarter. Summit Ridge, the default demo org, is a new owner-operator with no IFTA account, so it shows the not-set-up threshold with a demo link to Pioneer.
alternative: Make Summit Ridge an IFTA filer

title: Office work items
question: Create an Office work item per client-quarter so IFTA cases appear in My Work, Queues and Approvals too.

title: Approval button wording
question: The sprint says APPROVE FOR FILING; the contract says APPROVE RETURN.
